facts.fact: The previously proposed DOA estimation algorithm is deteriorated by non-speech interferences (NSI).
The paper develops a robust speaker DOA estimation algorithm.

facts.fact: The robust speaker DOA estimation algorithm is achieved by deriving the inter-sensor data ratio model of an AVS in bispectrum domain (BISDR).
